7947.title: Markdown drops Slack date fallback text
7947.rootCauseOneLine: Slack date syntax becomes a raw HTML node; the HTML parser turns it into a bogus comment and sanitization removes it.

prReviews.topFinding: Targets inline HTML nodes using timestamp formatting; no linked-branch execution or runtime verdict.

7947.proposedFix: Convert complete Slack date HTML nodes into plain text using their authored fallback before HTML parsing; leave code, surrounding HTML, comments, attributes, and sanitization unchanged.
7947.caveats: HTML-disabled rendering preserves raw tokens rather than dropping them. No macOS desktop or production-store inspection. Opaque HTML-block contents are outside the focused patch.
